hints.select: Click a Wall, Room, door or window to select it. Drag a Wall to move it (Shift: 100 mm, Ctrl: 1 mm). Delete removes it. F / Shift+F flip a selected door. Wheel: zoom, middle button: pan, F: fit.
hints.room: Drag a Room at the inside size you measured, or click and type width, Tab, depth, Enter. S: inside / outside size. Start on a Wall's far face to share it.
hints.wall: Drag a Wall, or click and type a length (then rotate with the mouse), Tab: angle, Enter. S: side of the thickness. Shift: 45°, Ctrl: 1°.
hints.separator: Drag a Room separator from one Wall face to another (or click both ends). It splits the area; the other part becomes a new Room.
hints.door: Move along a Wall to place a door: it shows the distance to both inside corners. Click to place, or type the distance, Tab, width, Tab, height, Enter. F: hinge side, Shift+F: swing.
hints.window: Move along a Wall to place a window: it shows the distance to both inside corners. Click to place, or type the distance, Tab, width, Tab, height, Tab, sill, Enter.
hints.wallOpening: Hover a Wall: the wall opening slides along it with its distances to both corners. Click places it; or type the distance, width, height and sill, Enter.
hints.garageDoor: Hover a Wall: the garage door slides along it with its distances to both corners. Click places it; or type the distance, width and height, Enter.
